intro: This is the street food Michelin inspectors queued up for themselves: 14 Bib Gourmand spots, from pushcarts to charcoal grills at the curb. Start with K. Panich, whose mango sticky rice follows a recipe handed down from the royal kitchens of Rama V and VI. Then Phuket's Pathongko Mae Pranee, where the second generation stuffs its fritters with crab and cheese, and Somsak Pu Ob, serving clay-pot crab and glass noodles fresh off the fire.
quickAnswerHtml: A lineup of 14 Bib Gourmand street food spots from the 2026 Michelin Guide Thailand, led by K. Panich and its royal-recipe mango sticky rice.

faq.q: Which street food spot should I try first?
faq.a: If you pick just one, make it K. Panich in Bangkok. Its mango sticky rice comes from a recipe passed down from the royal kitchens of Rama V and VI, sweetened with Chumphon coconut and Chiang Rai khao niao khiao ngu rice. One bite and you understand why Michelin singled it out.

A Pong Mae Sunee in Phuket, at 5 to 6 baht a piece, is an old-style coconut crepe grilled one at a time over charcoal, crisp at the edge and soft in the middle. Chiang Mai's Lung Khajohn Wat Ket also sells pork-filled sago dumplings at 20 baht for a box of seven.

faq.q: What is the must-try dish here?
faq.a: Somsak Pu Ob on Charoen Rat serves clay-pot crab and glass noodles baked over charcoal right on the street, and Jok Guay Jab in Khon Kaen does a Vietnamese-style pork rib noodle with pork sausage and a soft egg. Both were flagged by Michelin's inspectors.

faq.q: Where are these street food spots located?
faq.a: Chiang Mai has the most with four, followed by Bangkok and Khon Kaen with three each, Phuket with two, plus one apiece in Nakhon Ratchasima and Chon Buri. Chiang Mai alone covers Khao Soi Mae Sai, from 55 baht a bowl, and the nam ngiao rice noodles at Sanpakoi Kanomjeen.

faq.q: Are there any noodle or yentafo spots?
faq.a: Yes. Leng Yentafo in Khon Kaen pours a pink Yaowarat-style broth from a recipe over 40 years old, served with fish wontons and fish-and-shrimp balls made fresh daily. It is one of the noodle-focused entries that made the Bib Gourmand list.
